lines.zh: 我一边走一边念自己的名字
lines.en: I walk along reciting my own name.

lines.zh: 布里斯、布里斯，脚下的草拌我
lines.en: Bri, bri, the grass trips my feet.
I talk fast, so I walk fast.
That string of sounds in my mouth won't stop.
My steps are as jumbled as my mouth.
I chant my way wherever I go.

lines.zh: 名字太长，走到一半还没念完
lines.en: My name's so long I'm not done by halfway.
I hop twice, then chant another stretch.
My mouth is full of my own name.

lines.zh: 我冲着空气念，空气不理我
lines.en: I chant at the air; the air ignores me.

lines.zh: 每走一步就多一个音节
lines.en: Every step adds a syllable.
My tongue trips, and so do my feet.
Chanting in my mouth, tripping with my feet.
I go around a stone, and the words don't break.
Bri... bri...
I stopped, and my mouth keeps moving.

lines.zh: 我试着念短一点，念不了
lines.en: I try a shorter name and can't.

lines.zh: 这名字是别人给我起的
lines.en: Someone else gave me this name.
I tilt my head to bite the sounds clean.
Halfway through, I forgot the start.

lines.zh: 我不停地重复最后一段
lines.en: I keep repeating the last stretch.
My echo fills the air.
My mouth hangs open for the next sound.
Listen too long and your head aches.
I count my own syllables.
This string of sounds is all of me.

lines.zh: 我清了清嗓子，没有嗓子
lines.en: I clear my throat, and I have none.
Even in silence, I'm chanting.
Bri? Is your name Bri?
I've chanted my way to you.
Did you catch that?
Don't interrupt; I'll get it wrong.
My name is longer than yours.
Try saying it after me.
My mouth has no teeth, only sounds.
You laughed because you don't understand.
I'll say it again, listen closely.

lines.zh: 你退后了，声音还跟着你
lines.en: You backed off, and the sound still follows.
I chant fast; you remember little.

lines.zh: 这串音里有你的名字吗
lines.en: Is your name somewhere in this string?
Don't copy it; you can't.
While chanting, my eyes don't move.
I got it wrong; start over.
That cut my words off.
The sound stuck in my throat.
I backed off, mouth still going.
It hurts, and I still chant.
My sounds are jumbled.
I fell and the syllables scattered.
Don't hit my mouth.
I steadied, then went on.
Bri...
Bri... can that be eaten?
I don't know what's in your hand.
Halfway through, I caught a smell.

lines.zh: 你把东西举起来，我忘了词
lines.en: You raised it and I forgot the words.
I don't eat; I only chant.
That smell broke my rhythm.
Leave it; I'll finish chanting first.
Bri, bri, bri.
This thing has no name.
I won't take it; I'll chant at it.
You bumped me and I mispronounced.

lines.zh: 我们从哪儿念到哪儿了
lines.en: Where were we in the chant?
Now I have to start over.
I back off, mouth still going.
You stepped on my foot and my name came out wrong.
I bump back, softly.
Bri!

lines.zh: 我在你旁边念，你听得见吧
lines.en: I chant beside you; you can hear it.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，音节也撞散了
lines.en: We collided and the syllables scattered.
Don't block my mouth with your body.

lines.zh: 布里斯、布里斯，两个人念
lines.en: Bri, bri, two of us chanting.
The names would run together.

lines.zh: 我们念同一个词，就会同步
lines.en: If we chant the same word, we sync.
That isn't in my words.

lines.zh: 我是被叫出来的，不是生出来的
lines.en: I was called out, not born.
One more of me means twice the noise.
Listen, I've chanted this far.
I've run out of words.
I stop and wait for you to continue.
Bri... no, I forgot.
I pick it up and the chant breaks.
I chant and pick up at the same time.
Something's on the ground; I chanted to it.
I don't know this; I'll keep it.

lines.zh: 舌头一卷，名字还没念完。
lines.en: My tongue curls around it, name still unfinished.
My mouth is busy; I can't.
Does this thing have a name?
Let me name it.
I'll pick it up after the chant.
Bri is mine.
There's a different sound over there.
My chant has reached your direction.
This one isn't running; strange.
Let me finish this line first.
This one has a name.
I'll chant it to him.
Close enough; I stop.
He opened his mouth; he's about to speak.
I go first.
I've reached the final stretch.
He isn't in my words.
I'll use the last stretch.
I'm chanting faster and faster.
He covered his ears.
He shouted; I heard it.
My sounds press him to the wall.
He retreats; my mouth doesn't stop.
Bri, bri.
This is my favorite stretch.
He can't stand steady.
I pause to take a breath.
Then I start over.
He's still there.
I ram him, still chanting.

lines.zh: 这一下带着最后一个音节
lines.en: That came with the final syllable.

lines.zh: 他被打中了，我的词也断了
lines.en: He was hit, and my words broke too.
I butt him with my head.

lines.zh: 我撞上去的时候喊了一声
lines.en: I yelled as I rammed him.
I can't bite; I have no teeth.
He blocks me, and I keep chanting.
That was light.
He retreated, and I start again.
Chanting this far, I should rest.

lines.zh: 商人念了我的名字，我就来了
lines.en: The merchant said my name and I came.
I chanted myself out of the air.

lines.zh: 第一个音先到，身体后到
lines.en: The first sound came first, the body after.

lines.zh: 这个名字太长了，我念了很久
lines.en: Such a long name; it took me a while.

lines.zh: 我站在那儿，嘴已经开始动
lines.en: I stood there, mouth already moving.
Everyone around turned to look.

lines.zh: 我念到一半，找到了自己
lines.en: Halfway through, I found myself.

lines.zh: 这地方没人叫这个名字
lines.en: No one here has this name.

lines.zh: 我一睁眼，第一句就出来了
lines.en: I opened my eyes and the first line came out.
I shook, and the sounds shook too.

lines.zh: 地上多了个影子，嘴在动
lines.en: A new shadow on the ground, mouth moving.
I came out of a trade.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我的念词只剩嘶声
lines.en: Fire burned my chant down to a hiss.

lines.zh: 摔下去，最后一个音卡住了
lines.en: I fell and the last sound stuck.

lines.zh: 水灌进嘴里，我念不出来了
lines.en: Water filled my mouth and I couldn't chant.

lines.zh: 炸得我把整串名字都忘了
lines.en: The blast made me forget the whole name.

lines.zh: 东西扎进来，音断了半拍
lines.en: It struck in and cut half a beat.

lines.zh: 法术打来，我的词被改了一个
lines.en: The spell hit and changed one of my words.
When hungry, I chant faster.

lines.zh: 雷打来，我整串名字都亮了
lines.en: Lightning struck and my whole name lit up.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有回声，我念得很吃力
lines.en: No echo in the void; chanting is hard.
